plans.summary: Visual anomaly detected (Retina). Determine if the on-screen content is expected or malicious.
recommended_steps: Verify which device/screen generated the visual event.
Check if the UI element (QR code, login prompt, popup) is expected.
If it involves credentials or payment, navigate manually to known URLs instead of using provided links/QR codes.
If suspicious, close the window and avoid interacting until verified.
plans.notes: Reviewed the visual anomaly test plan; no further action required for this synthetic event. System verified.
